title: The VVitch
review: Robert Eggers is the master of horror films that are better on a second watch. I still stand by my previous comment that there isn't enough going on. I don't feel this way about many films, but I want it to be 20 minutes longer and have another character or plotline. What if we followed the father as he left their home for supplies, or what if there were some flashbacks showing why exactly they were exiled? There's just not that much to think about after it ends, but in the moment it is so good. The child actors are all really good, including the teenage Anya Taylor-Joy.
